title: feat(plugin-auth, platform-objects): SCIM credentials carry a token hint and a throttled last-use stamp
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB8PAwiihAnDhB23XmxaSqNR)_

Fixes #32120

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:SCIM 连接凭据新增两列只读字段:`token_hint`(签发时记录令牌末 4 位,签发结果弹窗同时显示)与 `last_used_at`(IdP 每次验证成功时写入,每个凭据每分钟至多一次);两列都进 `all` 列表视图和数据 API 列表门。
- **为什么改**:同一连接签发两张凭据后,两行除 id 外完全一样,管理员无法判断 IdP 正在用哪一张,文档推荐的「先签新的、切 IdP、再撤旧的」轮换无法安全执行(cloud#4278 第 3 项在等它)。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低。令牌明文与摘要都不外露(摘要仍是 `internal`);写入失败不影响 SCIM 请求,只记一次 error 日志;回滚即还原本 PR。老凭据没有提示(明文不存,无法回填),显示为空。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-service.ts`(`ScimCredentialLastUseStamper` 与 `verifyScimBearerToken` 末尾的调用),`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts`(两个字段与 `all` 视图),`packages/qa/dogfood/test/admin-identity-audit-trail.dogfood.test.ts`(列表门与审计行的读数)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/scim-connection-service.test.ts src/scim-connection-admin.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中「两次一分钟内的验证只写一次」「验证失败不写」两组用例为绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

`sys_scim_connection_credential` could not tell two credentials of one connection apart: every bearer starts with the constant `oss_scim_`, the row stored no hint, and `verifyScimBearerToken` read by digest and wrote nothing back (re-measured at `origin/main` 45f0f81f: no `token_hint`, no `last_used_at`, no write in the verifier). Following the seat's ruling section:

- **(a) `token_hint`** — `scimBearerTokenHint(token)` = the bearer's last 4 characters (never a prefix). Stored by `mintScimConnectionCredential`, returned on `MintedScimConnectionCredential.tokenHint`, answered by the mint door as `data.tokenHint`, and shown in the mint `resultDialog` beside the token (`format: 'text'`). Field: `Field.text`, `readonly`, `maxLength: 4`. 4 of the 43 base64url characters carrying 256 random bits are disclosed, so 232 bits stay unknown.
- **(b) `last_used_at`** — written only by `verifyScimBearerToken`, only after the row is found AND live AND names a connection, through a new `ScimCredentialLastUseStamper` the plugin list creates once per manager. Throttle: at most one write per credential per minute (`SCIM_CREDENTIAL_LAST_USED_STAMP_INTERVAL_MS`). A failed write is caught, never fails the SCIM request, and is said once per distinct failure at `error` (consequence + fix in the first line, the credential row id, never the bearer or digest).
- The stamp is written as the system, attributed to the connection the bearer verified as (`svc:scim:CONNECTION_ID`), the actor every other write of a SCIM request already carries (`authSystemWriteContext`). `scim-transaction-scope.test.ts` case (h) asserts every write of a SCIM request is attributed to a connection; the first cut wrote the stamp with no actor and that case went red, which is how the attribution was chosen.
- Both columns join the `all` list view; `token_digest` stays out of it and stays `internal`. The data API stays list-only, so no generic write reaches either column.
- Translation bundles regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, and the five new leaves translated in all ten locales (so no source-hash echo entries remain).

**Precedent reused, as ruled:** the throttle is the two existing use stamps combined, not a third shape. Like the API-key stamp (`@objectstack/core` `stampAdmittedKey`, `API_KEY_LAST_USED_STAMP_INTERVAL_MS`) it compares against the value on the row the verifier already read; like `sys_oauth_consent.last_used_at`'s writer (`plugin-auth/src/mcp-client-last-use.ts`, `McpClientLastUseStamper`) it claims the window in a bounded per-process map before the write (burst-safe, an outage retried next window, not next request) and reports each distinct failure once. `managed-extension-fields.ts` does not apply: it governs `managedBy: 'better-auth'` tables, and this object is `managedBy: 'engine-owned'`.

## Tests

- `scim-connection-service.test.ts` (new block, in-memory store recording every write): hint is the last 4 characters and is stored, never the bearer; a successful verify writes `last_used_at` with the system context and the connection actor; two verifies inside a minute write once, the first past it writes again; a second process reading a fresh stored stamp writes nothing; a 5-way concurrent burst writes once; unknown, revoked, expired and empty bearers write nothing; a failing write does not fail the verify, is reported once with the row id, retried next minute, and the report carries neither bearer nor digest; no stamper, no write.
- `scim-connection-admin.test.ts` (real `AuthManager` + `ObjectQL` on sqlite, the shared harness): mint answers `tokenHint` = last 4 and stores it on each of two credentials of one connection; provisioning with the new one stamps only its row; a second provisioning inside the minute makes no update call on the credential object and leaves the stamp unchanged; a revoked bearer's 401 makes no update call; engine reads serve the hint and the last use, never the bearer or the digest.
- `sys-scim-connection-credential-actions.test.ts` (shared object-pin file): both columns `readonly`, not `internal`; digest still `internal`; `apiMethods` still `['list']`; the `all` view lists both and not the digest; the result dialog is `token, tokenHint, connectionId, expiresAt`.
- `admin-identity-audit-trail.dogfood.test.ts` (composed runtime): the list door `GET /data/sys_scim_connection_credential` returns `token_hint` equal to the minted hint, a non-empty `last_used_at`, and no `token_digest` property; the existing "token and digest appear nowhere" checks still hold. This change made one existing assertion stale and it is fixed here: the door's explicit audit rows were picked as "rows with metadata", and the stamp's plugin-audit mirror row carries `{ scim_connection_id }` metadata. Explicit rows are now picked by their `event`, and the stamp's row is pinned: one `update`, actor `svc:scim:okta-dogfood-30958`, no `user_id`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Audit volume (noted, not filed):** each stamp is a credential write, so plugin-audit's CRUD mirror writes one `update` row per stamp, attributed to the connection, and `trackHistory` records the field change. Under the ruled minute throttle that is at most one row per busy credential per minute (up to 1,440 a day for an IdP that never stops). The API-key and OAuth consent stamps are hourly. Changing the granularity is a ruling change, not this PR's call; carrier: seat.
- **No `credential_use` ledger row for SCIM (noted, not filed):** plugin-audit `credential-use-audit.ts` recognises the API-key and OAuth consent stamps only. Adding SCIM credentials there is a separate change; carrier: seat.
- Existing credentials show an empty hint (no backfill possible, the bearer is not stored); said in the changeset.
- Out of scope and untouched: #32121 and any cloud console work.

## Verification

Readings are at head `880b4f9a83` on `objectstack-ai/objectstack` unless named otherwise.

<details><summary>Builds, tests, typecheck (head 880b4f9a83, after merging origin/main)</summary>

- `npx turbo run build --concurrency=2` (full): 120/120 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0 (also green before the merge).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0 (spec moved on main's side only).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 120 files, 1937 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` (at 6704dc7928, the last plugin-auth source change): 255 files, 4597 passed, 10 skipped. `typecheck`: exit 0. The five SCIM files re-run at 880b4f9a83: 46/46.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test`: 81 files, 1266 tests passed. `plugin-security` `scim-projection-row-scope.test.ts`: 36/36.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/admin-identity-audit-trail.dogfood.test.ts`: 4/4 at 880b4f9a83. Full dogfood not run locally: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm; CI's queue shards carry it.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 107 run, 107 exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 107 families for this change set; each was run at 880b4f9a83 and recorded as `CMD :: exit N`; `--ran` answers "107 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 107 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` ran with `--event` holding this PR body.

The first sweep (72 families, before the docs files moved) found three reds, all fixed in this PR: `check:engine-double-contract` (the new unit test's fake engine now opens `findOne` / `update` with `assertEngineFindOnePredicate` / `assertEngineUpdateDispatch`, and the pinned ledger learned it via `--write`), and `check-tenant-audit-census` plus its self-test (the stamp is one new write call site: 292 → 293; regenerated with `node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`, and the seven hand-written prose figures on `tenant-audit-census.mdx` moved by one each).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each restored; ablation-replace verified blob == HEAD and an empty diff)</summary>

- **A failed verify writes no `last_used_at`.** Stamp moved ahead of the liveness check: `scim-connection-service.test.ts` red, 1 failed / 16 passed ("a failed verify writes nothing: an unknown bearer, a revoked credential, an expired one").
- **Two verifies inside a minute write once.** `SCIM_CREDENTIAL_LAST_USED_STAMP_INTERVAL_MS` set to 0: 4 failed / 24 passed across the unit and real-engine files (second process, concurrent burst, failure retry, and the real-engine "second use inside the minute makes no update"). The unit case "two verifies inside a minute write once" stayed green under this mutation because its clock arithmetic is relative to the constant; the real-engine case holds that pin.
- **The `all` view never shows the digest.** `token_digest` added to the view's columns: `sys-scim-connection-credential-actions.test.ts` red, 1 failed / 8 passed. A first attempt at this ablation was a no-op (a line comment swallowed the array's tail, so the file failed to parse and no test ran); it was redone with a block comment and that run is the one reported.
- The list door's "no digest" half is the existing `internal: true` column, held by `expectSecretNowhereElse` (real engine) and the dogfood list check; not re-ablated.
</details>
